nodes.label: Plastic Film Rolls — Packaging Hero
nodes.visual_subject: Multiple rolls of transparent and tinted plastic film/stretch wrap arranged on a white background. Clear, pale blue, pale yellow and sage green rolls of varying heights; two smaller rolls at front. Clean, studio product-shot aesthetic.
nodes.mood_style: Minimalist, premium studio product photography; soft light, white background, neutral tones with subtle colour accent. Professional and clean.

nodes.label: Coloured Plastic Film Sheets — Packaging Macro
nodes.visual_subject: Close-up macro shot of overlapping transparent coloured plastic film strips/sheets — vivid blue, green, purple, amber, orange, and clear — arranged loosely with depth-of-field blur.
nodes.mood_style: Vibrant, colourful macro photography; shallow depth of field; glossy translucent surfaces; lively and energetic feel conveying colour-masterbatch versatility.

nodes.label: HDPE Plastic Pipes — Construction/Infrastructure Hero
nodes.visual_subject: Arrangement of black HDPE corrugated and smooth pipes of varying diameters (one labelled 'HDPE PE100 PN16 SDR11 315mm OD') on a white plinth against white background.
nodes.mood_style: Clean studio product photography; monochromatic dark grey/black palette against stark white; industrial and technical precision aesthetic.

nodes.label: Coloured Thread Spools — Textiles Hero
nodes.visual_subject: Array of large industrial thread/yarn spools in vivid colours — yellow, blue, orange, green, red, light blue, purple — arranged diagonally on a factory floor with machinery in background.
nodes.mood_style: Bright, colourful industrial photography; clean reflective factory-floor setting; energetic rainbow palette communicating colour breadth and manufacturing scale.

nodes.label: White Masterbatch Pellets
nodes.visual_subject: Macro close-up of a spread of small spherical white plastic masterbatch pellets/granules piled against a plain white background with soft shadow and depth of field.
nodes.mood_style: Minimalist, almost monochrome studio macro; soft natural light; clean and clinical; emphasises the purity and quality of white pigment masterbatch.

nodes.label: Multi-Core Power Cables — Wire & Cable Hero
nodes.visual_subject: Bundle of large-diameter black multi-core power cables (labelled H1ZZZ2-K HV 240mm²) draped over a grey plinth, exposing copper cores colour-coded red, blue, black, and yellow.
nodes.mood_style: Premium industrial product photography; muted grey/neutral background; technical precision; dramatic lighting highlighting cable cross-sections; authoritative and professional.

nodes.label: Greenhouse & Agricultural Film Rolls — Agriculture Industry
nodes.visual_subject: Stack of three large plastic film rolls on a concrete floor — dark green UV-stabilised shade netting, black greenhouse film, and dark green greenhouse film — each with branded labels ('Global Agri Solutions', 'Premium Greenhouse Film', '80% Shade', 'Made in EU').
nodes.mood_style: Documentary/commercial product photography; natural grey concrete floor; industrial scale; earthy dark green and black tones; practical and utilitarian feel.

nodes.label: Automotive Interior Plastic Components — Automotive Industry
nodes.visual_subject: Exploded arrangement of dark grey/black automotive interior plastic parts — dashboard fascia, centre console trim, steering wheel, gear selector surround, vents and electronic module housings — displayed on a white plinth in a bright studio.
nodes.mood_style: Clean, high-key studio product photography; desaturated monochrome parts; technical precision; sophisticated engineering aesthetic; black-and-white tonal scheme.

nodes.label: Black Geomembrane / Waterproof Liner Roll — Construction Industry
nodes.visual_subject: Close-up of a tightly wound roll of thick black textured geomembrane or waterproofing liner/sheet, showing ribbed surface texture, on a white/light background.
nodes.mood_style: Macro product photography; stark high-contrast; black material against white; emphasises material texture and robustness; serious and industrial.

nodes.label: Coloured Injection-Moulded Plastic Parts — Consumer Goods Industry
nodes.visual_subject: Flat-lay assortment of brightly coloured injection-moulded plastic component parts — gears, housings, frames, brackets — in red, blue, green, yellow, orange, teal; arranged in a grid pattern on a white background.
nodes.mood_style: Bright, vibrant flat-lay photography; white background; primary colour palette; playful yet organised; communicates colour variety and precision moulding capability.

edges.note: Both images represent the packaging industry; both depict plastic film/wrap materials used in packaging applications.
Both show plastic film rolls on a plain background; share material form (roll format, plastic film/sheet) though for different industries.
Both showcase vibrant colour ranges of plastic materials; both highlight the colour-masterbatch product diversity applicable across industries.
Both images feature vivid multi-colour palettes of plastic/fibre materials, communicating the breadth of available colours in masterbatch products.
Both images prominently feature vibrant primary colour arrays of manufactured plastic/fibre products, illustrating colour-masterbatch application scope.
Both represent construction/civil-engineering plastic applications: pipes for drainage/water infrastructure and geomembranes for waterproofing/lining.
Both are black/dark plastic products used in outdoor infrastructure; HDPE pipes are also widely used in agricultural irrigation.
Both are precision-engineered plastic-jacketed/moulded components used heavily in the automotive and electrical sectors; share dark-toned industrial aesthetic.
White masterbatch pellets are the upstream raw material that produces white or opaque plastic films used in the packaging industry.
Masterbatch pellets (white base + colour concentrate) are the direct precursor raw material to colour-moulded consumer goods plastic parts.
Masterbatch pellets are compounded into HDPE resin before pipe extrusion; pellets represent the upstream input for all plastic pipe products.
Masterbatch pellets are blended into cable jacket compounds; the white base pellet is a fundamental raw material for wire and cable sheathing.
Agricultural films are produced from polyethylene compounded with masterbatch; white and UV-stabiliser masterbatches are key inputs for greenhouse film.
Colour masterbatch pellets are used in fibre spinning to produce coloured synthetic yarns; white base pellets link to the textiles supply chain.
Masterbatch pellets are compounded into automotive-grade polymers; black and colour masterbatches are essential for automotive interior moulded parts.
Black and carbon-black masterbatch pellets are compounded into HDPE/LLDPE geomembrane sheets for UV resistance in construction applications.
Both are large-format dark plastic sheet/film products; geomembranes and agricultural mulch/liner films share similar polymer chemistry and extrusion production process.
